title: Postern error response
description: Body of every non-2xx Postern response. See SPEC.md section 2.1. The root is closed: nothing may sit beside error, so this envelope has one extension point rather than two, and a client finds the whole failure under one key. That constrains what a conforming implementation emits — a client MUST NOT reject a response for carrying a sibling it does not recognise.

code.description: The codes a conforming implementation emits. A client MUST tolerate a code outside this set, treating it as a generic failure of its HTTP status class (SPEC.md section 2.1) — this enum is not a licence to reject. not_entitled is only valid from a local runner reporting its own state. Distributors MUST answer not_found instead, so the entitlement endpoint cannot be used to enumerate a private catalogue.

message.description: Human-readable; SHOULD be safe to show a user verbatim.

detail.description: Structured data about this failure, and the envelope's extension point: because the root is closed, whatever a bare code and message cannot carry rides here. SPEC.md section 5.6 defines one member so far — access_ends_at, the RFC 3339 date a withdrawn agent's access ends.
